selector.title: Selector
selector.help: ← → navigate · Enter select · 1-9 jump · M switch mode · Esc close
selector.emptyDescription: Pin up to 6 cards from the main window to see them here.

float.title: ThreadTerm · Floating Terminal
float.emptyTitle: No session attached to the floating window yet.
float.emptyDescription: Press <kbd>{{shortcut}}</kbd> on the main window to pick a pinned session.

slotB.title: Recycle floating terminal
slotB.description: Send the floating session back into the main window.

hotkeys.title: Overlay hotkeys
hotkeys.scope: OS-level · works when ThreadTerm is in the background
hotkeys.tips: Tips: use a combination that's unlikely to clash with your OS / other apps (e.g. add Shift + Alt). If the OS refuses to register a binding (for example when another app already owns it), the old accelerator stays active.
